scope: Published common envelope for AMD-listed MI50 16GB and 32GB SKUs, with board-revision-specific internal geometry kept separate. Detailed teardown geometry currently represents a genuine 16GB specimen only.

board_length.note: AMD separately lists 10.5 in (267 mm) for both the MI50 16GB and MI50 32GB product pages.

board_height.note: AMD lists Full Height for both SKUs. 111.15 mm is a PCIe form-factor nominal from an earlier CEM reference, not a card-specific measurement.

slot_envelope_thickness.note: AMD lists Double Slot for both SKUs, not an exact assembled thickness.

original_cover_thickness.note: 0.5 mm is a user-supplied estimate. Public teardown confirms a removable outer shroud but provides no sheet-thickness measurement.

deshrouded_cooler_thickness.note: 35–37 mm is a user-supplied estimate. Public teardown images show separate black heatsink and silver vapor-chamber fin regions but provide no calibrated thickness measurement.

vega_package_footprint.note: Candidate value supplied in the 2026-11-20 research discussion. Do not treat as confirmed for Vega 20/MI50: the commonly cited 47.3 mm Vega Frontier Edition source is about Vega 10, not Vega 20. No MI50-specific package outline or source tying FCBGA-1933 to this body size has been located.

fin_gap.note: Sensitivity-study range only; fin pitch/free area not publicly measured.

fin_thickness.note: Sensitivity-study range only; fin thickness not publicly measured.

outer_shroud_screw_count.note: Teardown author reports six small outer-shroud screws on the genuine 16GB specimen; exact locations and thread size not published.

vapor_chamber_fastener_count.note: Teardown author reports four screws retaining the vapor chamber; exact coordinates and fastener specification not published.

value: copper vapor chamber with silver fin stack
cooler_regions.note: The teardown photo supports two visually distinct adjacent longitudinal fin fields on the 16GB specimen. Do not assume their exact vertical stacking or transfer the geometry to the 32GB SKU.

outer_shroud_fastener_thread.note: The public teardown confirms six small outer-shroud screws, but does not identify their thread size. Do not model M2 threads or bosses as final-fit geometry until confirmed.

cooler_fin_architecture.note: Two visually distinct fin regions are visible. Exact relative height, pitch, thickness, open area and spatial relationship require measurement.

mi50_16gb.teardown_sample_identity: Author identifies genuine AMD MI50 16GB; teardown text distinguishes it from a Radeon VII-like Chinese card.
mi50_16gb.mechanical_confidence: medium for qualitative cooler architecture; low for undocumented dimensions
notes: The available exposed-heatsink photographs and six-cover-screw/four-vapor-chamber-fastener observations are for this 16GB specimen.
Do not assume every OEM/reworked 16GB board shares the same cooler or PCB.

mi50_32gb.mechanical_confidence: low for internal mechanical equivalence; AMD publishes same outer envelope but no detailed cooler drawing located
notes: AMD publishes the same external form-factor categories and length as the 16GB SKU.
No directly inspected 32GB MI50 teardown or dimensioned cooler drawing has been established in this research pass.

A community-maintained VBIOS/hardware reference reports original-AMD and modified/simplified Chinese 32GB PCB variants; treat this as a variant-identification warning, not a verified mechanical drawing.
Do not assume 16GB heatsink, HBM stack height, component layout, or mounting coordinates transfer unchanged.

board_revision_policy.rule: Memory capacity is not a sufficient mechanical revision identifier. Store vendor, PCB revision, subsystem IDs, VBIOS part number, cooler part number, and measured geometry as separate identity fields.

community_reported_32gb_variants.reported_visual_clue: multiple backplate stickers versus one sticker
community_reported_32gb_variants.confidence: low; community-reported and internally inconsistent with AMD official MI50 32GB compute-unit specification
community_reported_32gb_variants.cad_policy: do not create separate geometry solely from this report; require physical photos, IDs, or measurements
notes: The community table describes an original 32GB board as 64 CUs / 4096 shaders, but AMD official MI50 32GB specifications list 60 CUs / 3840 stream processors.
The reported 60-ROP/240-TMU versus 64-ROP/256-TMU distinction may reflect a different GPU SKU or board identity; do not use it to identify a mechanical revision until reconciled.
The backplate sticker-count clue is not sufficient evidence of a distinct cooler or PCB geometry.

counterfeit_or_reworked_card_warning.reported_distinction: teardown author distinguishes genuine MI50 16GB (PCI device ID 1002:66A1) from a Radeon-VII-like Chinese card (1002:66AF)
counterfeit_or_reworked_card_warning.cad_policy: identify actual board before applying the MI50 reference geometry

board_revision_policy.cad_policy: Do not create separate geometry solely from this report; first reconcile product identity against AMD specifications, VBIOS P/N, PCI subsystem IDs, board labels, photos, and physical measurements.

image_observations.specimen: genuine MI50 16GB per teardown article context
observations: The exposed assembly visibly contains a long black fin field and a visually distinct silver finned vapor-chamber cooler assembly.
In the top-down photograph, the two visible fin fields occupy adjacent longitudinal regions; the image does not establish exact overlap, Z-height offset, or their internal contact geometry.
The photo is not calibrated metrology. Pixel proportions must not be converted to dimensions without a known scale in the same plane and perspective correction.
Fin ridges/channels are visually dense, but pitch, thickness, depth, free area, and intended airflow direction are not measurable from this image alone.

variant_research_notes: AMD official 16GB and 32GB product pages both list 60 CUs and 3,840 stream processors, 300 W peak, passive cooling, Full Height, 267 mm length, Double Slot.
A community VBIOS gist reports two 32GB board families, original AMD and simplified Chinese PCB, with different ROP/TMU counts and sticker patterns. Low-confidence identification lead only.
The community report original-32GB 64-CU/4,096-shader claim conflicts with AMD official MI50 32GB specification (60 CUs/3,840 stream processors). Do not infer mechanical revision from this claim.
The community VBIOS matrix lists 113-D1631711-100 and 113-D1631700-111 for 32GB cards; these are firmware part numbers, not heatsink part numbers.
Public seller photos show multiple external cooler/shroud appearances on cards advertised as MI50 32GB, but seller listings do not establish PCB revision or internal cooler geometry.
